title: MyNote Page Content
description: Canvas content of a single chapter note, page, or subpage — stored at '{folder}/page.json'. 'folder' is '{dataRoot}/{notebookId}/{sectionId}/page.json' for a chapter's own note, or '{dataRoot}/{notebookId}/{sectionId}/{...pageIdChain}/page.json' for a page/subpage. The file is created by the first content save, not when the page is created. Describes what MyNote writes. The loader (parsePageContent in application/src/renderer/src/canvas/model.ts) is more lenient: it fills a missing 'pageId' with the id of the opened content and a missing 'elements' with [], keeps unknown fields on the page and on every element, and rejects a text box without finite numbers or an object 'content' as a corrupt file. See documentation/software/file-format/file-format.md.

pageId.description: Id of the section (chapter note) or page/subpage this content belongs to. Matches the last id in the folder's path.

elements.description: Free-canvas elements, each absolutely positioned via x/y/width/height/zIndex. Only 'textbox' elements are drawn; every other element is kept and saved unchanged.

canvasElement.description: A text box, or a foreign element of another type. The loader only needs a string 'id' and a string 'type' from an element and checks the geometry of a text box.

content.description: TipTap ProseMirror JSON document, see tiptap-document.schema.json.

imageElement.description: Legacy: written by other branches of v0.1.x. MyNote never creates one and never draws it; it is kept in the file. The loader does not check its fields.

assetPath.description: Path relative to this page's own 'assets/' subfolder.

fileElement.description: Legacy: written by other branches of v0.1.x. MyNote never creates one and never draws it; it is kept in the file. The loader does not check its fields.

assetPath.description: Path relative to this page's own 'assets/' subfolder.

foreignElement.description: Any element of another type (ForeignElement in canvas/model.ts): kept with all its fields, never drawn.
